item.name: Dr. Harlow
item.whenAppears: After early patients; end of each shift
item.interaction: Grades your shift, unlocks shutters and cameras after shift 1, opens the shop and rooms 6-8 on shift 2, and unlocks the taser on shift 3. Later lore talks happen if you walk up to him in the lobby.
item.rewardOrUse: Unlocks check-in tools, the shop, emergency rooms, and the taser
item.cardSummary: The hospital doctor who runs your early unlocks and grades each shift. When Harlow shows up, a new tool or facility is usually about to open.

item.name: Shop Nurse
item.interaction: Runs the Supplies Shop after Dr. Harlow unlocks it. Buy tools, consumables, and support items with in-game currency.
item.rewardOrUse: Buy extinguishers, tasers, upgrades, and support items
item.cardSummary: The face of the staff shop. Once Harlow opens the store, this is where you stock gear between patient rushes.

item.name: Ron from Accounting
item.interaction: Talks about hospital threats, past intern deaths, and Animal Corporation secrets. Shares practical survival notes on enemies like the Bed Monster, Mass of Eyes, and Stalker.
item.rewardOrUse: Survival tips for anomalies, room threats, and hospital lore
item.cardSummary: A calm blue rabbit with a TOP SECRET suitcase and a long memory. Talk to Ron when you want monster advice more than a treatment item.

item.name: Ratthew
item.whenAppears: Recurring visits; key often near shifts 8-10
item.interaction: Serve him through a short dialogue chain. He starts cautious, warns you not to trust anyone, talks about his missing twin Rattina, then leaves a key after enough visits.
item.rewardOrUse: Key for the Room 5 safe (Rattina photo and TOP SECRET suitcase)
item.cardSummary: A small black rat who looks anomaly-adjacent but is a real visitor. Keep serving him if you want the key that opens the Room 5 lore safe.

item.name: Barney
item.whenAppears: Shifts 2-7 (up to three times in one shift)
item.interaction: Asks for coffee, a briefcase hold, a photo, a scalpel, and later a place to hide. Refusing coffee too long can draw threats. His photo shows a sharp-toothed anomaly face.
item.rewardOrUse: Extra coffee machine (300s cooldown) if you hide him and do not turn him in
item.cardSummary: A polite guest with a long favor chain and a wanted poster waiting later. Coffee and patience matter more than treatment tools.

item.name: Officer Duckman
item.whenAppears: After you accept Barney's hide request
item.interaction: Shows a photo of Barney and asks if you have seen him. You can turn Barney in or stay quiet. Turning him in triggers a fight that can leave Duckman fainted and needing treatment.
item.rewardOrUse: Story choice during Barney's ending; no special gift for turning Barney in
item.cardSummary: The law side of Barney's route. He only shows up once you hide Barney, and the choice is whether you talk or keep quiet.

item.name: Rattina
item.whenAppears: Photo and safe contents only (not a live visitor)
item.interaction: Learned through Ratthew's later talks and the Room 5 safe. She looks like Ratthew with eyelashes and a purple bow, and worked for Animal Corporation before vanishing.
item.rewardOrUse: Lore for the key safe and Animal Corporation mystery
item.cardSummary: Ratthew's twin and the smart one of the family. You meet her story through the key route, not as a check-in patient.
